Hi Sophie — Rafael from Billing here. I pushed the first-pass session-level export to the Drive link below (summary attached). Key findings from the sampling:

- For 2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-12 we observed ~11k sessions where both legacy ingestion and the streaming aggregator reported token increments; in those cases our dedupe/aggregation had a flaw for sessions that were flagged as "in-flight" during the migration window. That explains roughly 29% of the spike you saw.
- Another ~12% of the increase is attributable to a change in attribution rules where system-level assistant messages were previously attributed to a background route and are now attributed to the customer route. This was an intentional change but we did not surface it proactively — apologies.
- Remaining delta (~4%) is noise from sampling variance between client-side tokenizers and our server-side tokenizer.

Proposed remedial actions (short-term):
1) We will issue a pro-rated credit for the dedupe-related overcount for 2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-12 (calculation attached).
2) For attribution changes we can either retroactively reclassify those assistant messages to the background route for your account for the current cycle or offer a one-time offset credit while we implement a configurable attribution flag for you.
3) We will provide a cleaned session export (deduped + consistently attributed) and a reconciliation CSV that maps your client_trace_id values to our session ids.

I attached a draft collection plan (collection-plan-draft.pdf) that outlines the credit amounts, timing, and a proposed sign-off workflow (Sophie to confirm acceptance). If you want to expedite, we can accelerate the credit to appear on the next invoice; otherwise it will be processed as a pro-rata credit applied immediately and visible on the next statement.

Link to exports: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d5e
Attachments: collection-plan-draft.pdf, usage_export_sample_summary.txt

Please let me know which option (retro reclass or offset credit) you prefer and whether your procurement team needs a formal adjust/credit memo.

Thanks,
